title: Yogashikha Upanishad
author: Anonymous (Krishna Yajurveda yoga Upanishad)
year: medieval; no PD English translation located
locator_hints: Ch. 1 on the signs of yoga, nada and jyoti
summary: A medieval yoga Upanishad on hatha and nada practice, said to discuss inner sound and the lights of laya practice. Not contained in Narayanasvami Aiyar's Thirty Minor Upanishads (1914), the only public-domain English yoga-Upanishad collection on disk; no other free English translation was located in this pass. Recorded as a gap.
why_relevant: Belongs with Mandalabrahmana, Advayataraka and Dhyanabindu as a classical yoga-Upanishad source on signs of practice; contents unverified.
notes: No URL verified; no free English text located.
